description:
List your preference polls (taste runs), newest first. Continue until there is no nextCursor, even after a short page. New runs shift pages; restart for fresh results.
Use for: finding your preference polls and their status.
Not for: reading one run’s votes, tally and report (get_taste_run); listing QA runs (list_qa_runs).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_taste_runs({"limit":20})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

limit.description: Rows wanted. A page can hold fewer, or none; only a page without nextCursor is the end.

name: list_taste_runs

data.description: Up to 100 across pages. Some newer runs may be missing.

acceptedRespondentCount.description: People accepted onto the run so far. For the votes counted, read get_taste_run.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

status.description: blocked_awaiting_funds: waiting for money in your wallet. collecting: people are voting. reviewing: votes are being checked. closed: done, see report. cancelling, cancelled, expired, failed: over without a full result.

title: List taste runs
